create_simplenet_with_lstm: create a SimpleNet actor-critic model with LSTM for reinforcement learning on multiple training jobs
create_simplenet_without_lstm: create a SimpleNet feedforward actor-critic model without LSTM for single environment reinforcement learning
run_simplenet_forward_training: run the SimpleNet forward pass in training mode to sample actions and compute baseline values
run_simplenet_forward_eval: run the SimpleNet forward pass in eval mode to greedily select actions without sampling
review_simplenet_initial_state: review the SimpleNet initial_state method that returns zero-initialized LSTM hidden state tuples
